The following compounds were all found to be components of a sample of petrol.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Write an equation to represent the complete combustion of compound **H**.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Fossil fuels are often contaminated with sulfur.

State and explain why supplies of fossil fuels that contain sulfur pose a problem to the environment.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The boiling points of compounds **G**, **H** and **J** are shown below.

| compound | **G** | **H** | **J** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| boiling point/$^{\circ}\text{C}$ | 0 | 99 | 112 |

Explain the differences in the boiling points of the three compounds.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Compound **J** can be produced from 2-chloro-3-methylbutane, $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\text{Cl}$.

Give the reagent(s) and conditions for this reaction.
